I have a funded PhD studentship available (at LFCS, Uni of Edinburgh) to anyone with a good proposal related to PL/FM. In particular I'm hoping to work with someone on my Quickstrom project. More details here: http://liamoc.net/work_with_me.html

Please contact me if interested, or forward this message to anyone who might be.

With best wishes,
Liam
